scope: Native CMenuBloodBath hub and portable multiplayer configuration and in-session pages.

references.purpose: Main's BLOODBATH row opens the hub in retail and a promotional screen in the demo.
The Bloodbath menu has Main as its parent and uses the shared title and options positions.
Build uses interface/mainmenus/bloodbath.pcx, zero extra spacing and the three large rows in Join, Host and Character Setup order.
IDS_MENU_TITLE_BLOODBATH 453 and IDS_MENU_BLOODBATH_JOIN, HOST and CHARSETUP 506–508.
English title and action labels corresponding to the mounted cres.dll strings.

adaptations: The application supplies the hub rows and uses the same typed native menu for Host, Join, Character Setup, rotation, LAN and in-session commands.
The original networking wizard and character screen have portable menu pages that drive the M9 ENet session and profile.
The title artwork is read from the player's mounted data, with a native bitmap font title available as a fallback.
